raw_comment:
This map of the United States displays the levels of drought present in each area of the country. I noticed that the levels of drought become more extreme near the middle of the country. This is because these regions are further from the ocean. I was surprised that the level of drought was not higher in the western region of the country because they usually experience severe fires. The severeness of droughts have increased in recent years due to global warming. I wonder what scientists have been doing to combat this issue. This relates to my community because the increase in droughts can affect the food supply and water quality. This would be catastrophic for my state. 
Headline: Where is the rain!?
